title: Find yourself in the Psalms and prayers

segments.en: Also when one says Psalms, or “Chatzoas” (the midnight rectification), or other entreaties and supplications, he needs to find himself in them (-to see how they pertain to him personally). And see inside (the source) wondrous discourses in these matters.
(Likutay Moharan II, Torah 101, Outpouring of the Soul 9)
